title: Restore parent auth.json after pre_start before compose up
description:
GIG-4063 restores parent auth.json only after the whole worktree up finishes. Apollo's container entrypoint runs composer install during that up, so a pre_start hook that wrote .env Nova credentials is what Composer uses.

Always overwrite-seed parent auth.json before up. Restore it again immediately after host pre_start and before Docker starts.

## Goal

Worktree composer install must use the parent checkout's working Nova credentials, not a different .env account.
